description: Full listing: SKUs with ids and live stock, quantity price tiers (USD per sale unit), MOQ, carton packing (units per carton, size, gross weight), country of origin and its export HS code (hs_code; for China also hs_code_cn, the 10-digit Chinese customs code), battery/liquid/magnet/powder flags, certifications and the supplier's Moqway rating. 'unit' and pieces_per_unit say what one unit is (a piece, or a pack such as 1,000 pcs); quote_order quantities count the same units. Use the sku_id values in quote_order.
name: get_product
title: Get product details
